title: A fair agreement brings an ending
meaning: A sequential discussion of honest terms helps you finish with a sense that the important parts of a question have been heard and agreed.
text: An argument can be easier to finish when its outcome makes sense to both people. The Emperor in the physical position of Vishuddha helps formulate terms in sequence: naming a request, hearing a reply and clarifying the actual extent of a promise. Justice in energy supports a wish to consider both sides and match words to possibilities. The World in emotions responds with wholeness. Separate parts find their place, leaving the exchange free to end. You can leave with an agreement to return to rather than relief at silence alone.

For example, you discuss responsibility for items borrowed from each other for work. Specific terms about returning them and giving notice turn many old details into an understandable rule. **A whole outcome gives words a place in everyday life.** You can acknowledge different habits and still agree on an achievable response to a request. Conversation ends because what mattered has been heard.

The difficulty appears if a sense of complete order requires every exception. Almost finished, the exchange gains another qualification that reopens the argument. The intention to agree fairly stays useful. Wholeness can exist without an exhaustive rulebook: sufficiently clear consent can apply now while leaving a genuinely new circumstance room for discussion later.
